title: Hoe5x5
description: A vanilla-style 5x5 farm hoe datapack for harvesting, replanting, and tilling farmland in Minecraft 26.2.
body:
This datapack uses vanilla commands to break the extra blocks, so some plugin-based systems may only detect the first block broken by the player.


Hoe description

markdown id="5q8yvb"
Emerald 5x5 Farm Hoe

Emerald 5x5 Farm Hoe is a vanilla-style datapack that adds a special netherite hoe for farming in a 5x5 area.

This datapack is designed for Minecraft / Paper 26.2 and does not require any mods or plugins.

Features

- Adds a custom 5x5 netherite farm hoe
- Harvests mature crops in a 5x5 area
- Replants supported crops automatically
- Turns dirt-like blocks into farmland in a 5x5 area
- Uses vanilla datapack commands
- Includes an enchantment glint effect
- Does not change vanilla textures
- Works separately from normal netherite hoes

Supported crops

- Wheat
- Carrots
- Potatoes
- Beetroots
- Nether wart

Commands

Give yourself the hoe:

mcfunction
/function hoe3x3:give
